data.name: Kebabstar 🌯⭐
data.detailed_description:
KEBABSTAR: MORE THAN A GAME

THEY TOOK EVERYTHING. THEY MISSED ONE THING.

ONLY SLAVES FEED FROM THE MASTER'S HAND.

You were a kebab seller with a cart, a camel, and the best skewers on the street. The Ice Cream Cult burned it all down and shipped your camel to their island. What they didn't check: the camel had a tracker.

Now, with a strange pair of agentic glasses that shouldn't exist and a signal pointing straight at Cyprus, you're hunting the cult and the tech company funding it.

GRILL BY DAY. INFILTRATE BY NIGHT

Run your stand and perfect your craft. The shortest path to a man's secrets runs through his stomach. Then trade the apron for a suit and walk into penthouse parties full of people who own yachts and consciences in equal number. 

MELT THE CULT IN CYPRUS!

Witness the extraordinary and epic journey of a humble kebab seller who becomes a technologic Agent after losing everything in the desert. Your mission? To destroy this sinister cult and the tech company behind it deep within Cyprus.

From flipping kebabs on the streets to partying in luxury parties, you’ll rise through the ranks and transform into an elite agent. In this epic and hilarious simulation, cook kebabs, charm the ladies, and shoot the fire!


                              "And when charm runs out, ammunition doesn't."

FEEL YOUR REAL HANDS

You're not just an agent or AI agent... You're stepping into the full cooking experience, one step at a time. Feel the grip of the knife, hold the pan, mix the ingredients, and become a true chef as you master the art of kebab-making.

COOKING LIKE NEVER BEFORE

Unlike any other game, Kebabstar uses advanced inverse kinematics to deliver a hyper-realistic cooking experience where your hero’s hands move just like your own.

YOU ARE DIFFERENT.

You're not just an ordinary kebab master;

MEET WITH THE CAST

To the street, you're a kebab master. To the cult, you're a ghost with a grill.

Nobody knows both halves of you. That's the only reason you're still breathing.

THE GLASSES  —  An AI that reviewed your life and concluded it could run it better. Sarcastic. Relentless. Technically on your side.

THE BLIND MAN  —  Sees the entire conspiracy. Refuses to explain it in any useful order.

THE CULT  —  Smiling, well-funded, and utterly convinced they're the heroes of this story.

YOUR RIVALS  —  Some of them answer to the cult now.

FROM KEBAB MASTER TO SECRET AGENT

Perfect the grill. Undercut every rival on the street. Go viral. Get rich.

Then the Ice Cream Cult burns it all down and ships your camel to their island. At rock bottom in the desert, you find a pair of glasses that shouldn't exist. They know your name. They know where she is. They have a proposition.

What the cult never checked: the camel had a tracker.

ADVENTURE, ROMANCE & CATASTROPHIC DECISIONS

Monday you're broke in the sand. Friday you're holding a drink in a Dubai penthouse, surrounded by the people funding the cult — and not one of them knows your face.

Cook your way in. Charm your way deeper. And when the conversation ends, the apron comes off.

RICH AND DIFFERENT, ONE SIGNAL

  • ARABIA  —  where you lost everything and found the glasses

  • ISTANBUL  —  the Grand Bazaar: crowds, customers, and the message

  • DUBAI  —  beach and the money behind the cult

  • CYPRUS  —  the Turkish Island.

Every region hides its own missions, its own characters, and one more piece of the conspiracy.

BUILT TO BE STARED AT CUTTING EDGE TECHNOLOGY

Unreal Engine 5. Nanite renders every skewer, stall, and crowded alley in full geometric detail. Lumen lights it in real time grill fire flickering across your face.

"Yes, the kebabs look real enough to smell,

No, we're not sorry."

data.short_description: Your camel: stolen. Their mistake: it has a tracker. Grill kebabs by day. Infiltrate billionaire parties by night. Follow the signal to the Ice Cream Cult's island fortress. Become the world's first AI secret agent and kill the enemies.
